personal.name: Moonis Ahmed
personal.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
personal.tagline: 7 years building enterprise-grade SaaS products. From test automation to React + GraphQL features serving 100K+ users.

bio: I'm a full stack software engineer with a strong foundation in both frontend development and test automation. I've spent 7 years at Replicon and Deltek shipping end-to-end features — from technical design through production launch.

I care about code quality, developer experience, and building systems that are resilient and maintainable. Outside of coding, I'm passionate about AI tooling and leveraging it to accelerate engineering workflows.
Degree in Computer Science (Software Engineering) from the University of Calgary.

work.title: Software Engineer III · Full Stack
work.description: Led full-stack feature development for a professional services automation SaaS product serving enterprise clients. Worked across React, Apollo GraphQL, and AWS while collaborating with product, design, QA, and senior engineering.
bullets: Built an AI-assisted test triage tool that reduced pipeline failure diagnosis from hours to minutes.
Upgraded the frontend and middleware stack to the latest React and Apollo/GraphQL versions with minimal disruption.
Built a modern integration testing framework and migrated legacy tests, enabling early MVP readiness.
Mentored junior developers and coordinated cross-team stakeholder handoffs for timely feature rollouts.
Won internal AI Hackathon (2025) for applied prompt engineering and AI tooling innovations.

work.title: Software Developer · Test Automation
work.description: Zero-to-one contributor on a new professional services automation product. Owned test automation infrastructure end-to-end and drove major improvements in release reliability and cost efficiency.
bullets: Automated UI testing with Puppeteer, Selenium, and WebdriverIO — compressed the release cycle from 5 days to 1.
Migrated testing infra from BrowserStack to AWS Device Farm, cutting annual testing costs by 90%.
Led on-call incident response, running structured root cause analyses and no-blame postmortems.
Honored as Replicon MVP (Q3 2019) for measurable technical impact and team leadership.

work.title: Software Developer Intern
work.description: Developed a community hub for ESDC managers using Node.js and the SharePoint REST API. Participated in daily scrums and release planning with stakeholders.
